session_notes: Very heavy scaffolding. Most actions were teacher-demonstrated (Merve demonstrates Fat threshold; Oğuz demonstrates threshold iteration 11→10→9→8→7). Depth-2 built. Test switch was Oğuz's instruction. Almost no independent behavioral evidence meets Acquire criteria unassisted.

B2.note: All threshold iterations in observation log are attributed to Oğuz Hoca or Merve demonstrating. No Frank-initiated movable value adjustment documented. not_observed.

B6.note: Same issue — no Frank-initiated threshold change. not_observed.

B9.note: Test switch was explicit teacher instruction: 'Şimdi test dataseti açıyoruz.' Frank followed but no anticipatory or reflective statement documented. not_observed per Section 6.
